definitions.explanation: A grammatical number referring to one person or thing, as opposed to plural.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単数|たんすう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}する→区別する：26970_kubetsusuru⟧。
examples.english: In English, singular and plural are distinguished.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単数|たんすう}⟦{形|けい}→形：noentry⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This noun is in singular form.

examples.japanese: {単数|たんすう}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧。

notes:
{単数|たんすう} is a grammar term meaning 'singular number,' primarily used when discussing languages like English that distinguish between singular and plural.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {単数|たんすう}⟦{形|けい}→形：noentry⟧: singular form
- {単数|たんすう}⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧: singular noun
- {単数|たんすう}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: treated as singular
- {単数|たんすう}・⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧: singular and plural

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単数|たんすう}: singular (one)
- ⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧: plural (more than one)

USAGE:
Japanese does not grammatically distinguish singular and plural in most cases, so this term appears mainly in foreign language study, linguistics, and translation contexts. Learners of English encounter it frequently when studying grammar (⟦{英文法|えいぶんぽう}→英文法：17489_eibunpou⟧).

REGISTER:
Formal/technical. Rarely used outside academic or language-learning contexts.
